segments.motivation: Overseeing project progress, coordinating team efforts, and ensuring task completion.
Managing personal tasks, understanding priorities, and collaborating efficiently within a team.
Organizing overall business operations, managing small teams, and maximizing productivity with an intuitive tool.

tasks.purpose: to define responsibilities and set clear deadlines
to ensure accountability and monitor advancement
to share updates, feedback, and files efficiently

benefits.claim: The tool provides clear insights into project status, task advancement, and overall performance.
It centralizes discussions, updates, and files, fostering efficient teamwork and shared understanding.
Users find it helps organize daily tasks and larger projects, leading to streamlined operations and increased output.

frictions.claim: The extensive number of features and options can sometimes make the interface feel overwhelming or cumbersome to navigate.
Reviewers report issues with the volume of email notifications or difficulty tracking discussions within long comment threads.
Some advanced and useful features, such as comprehensive timelines and reporting, are restricted to higher-tier pricing plans.
